title: How Jack Friks found a working TikTok format and hit $3.2k MRR in week 6 of a couples app
summary: Jack updates his 2-month push to build a $10k/month consumer app. A daily burner-phone TikTok routine found a replicable video format that drove 11,000 downloads in 48 hours. He then moved the app to freemium and plans to reinvest into UGC creator accounts to scale the format.

principles.text: Don't invent a format: scroll a fresh account, find videos in your niche that already performed, and recreate them.
principles.quote: You're not trying to recreate the wheel here.

principles.text: Native-feeling videos that show a cool feature beat ads; people forgive the app being visible if the feature is something they want.
principles.quote: it's showcasing a really cool feature that they want. So that's enough to get over that hill of appearing as an ad.

principles.text: Optimize for downloads, not views: judge formats by conversion to installs, since views can be misleading.
principles.quote: this one gets 100k views and brings in a th000 downloads so this format is clearly much better

principles.text: Reach your exact audience: target the people who'd use the product together, here couples downloading a couples app.
principles.quote: that's really the goal is to get couples to download the couples app.

principles.text: Seed deliberate small errors to trigger comments; the algorithm rewards comment activity.
principles.quote: The algorithm loves when people comment. If they're commenting, they're watching the video.

principles.text: Once a format works, milk it with repetition and scale it across many accounts using UGC creators, accepting it will eventually wear out.
principles.quote: Eventually it won't work so effectively. It will be overused but for now um basically going to milk it.
